blurb: Ponce City Market is Atlanta's coolest destination, tucked inside the city's hippest neighborhood on the BeltLine. Housed in a converted Sears, Roebuck & Co. building this curated food hall is packed with some of Atlanta's best restaurants. Along the way, you'll sink your teeth into an award-winning cheeseburger from James Beard Award winner Chef Linton Hopkins, plus a toasty Cuban sandwich from James Beard Award nominee Chef Hector Santiago the kind of bites locals actually line up for. Your guide will walk you through the building's fascinating history, from mail-order catalog warehouse to Atlanta's most-loved gathering spot, sharing the stories and quirky details most visitors never hear. Then you'll stroll along the Atlanta BeltLine's Eastside Trail, taking in the ever-changing street art scene that makes this stretch of the city so iconic. Part food crawl, part history lesson, part outdoor adventure this tour is the ultimate way to learn about Atlanta and eat like a local!
